## About Harpreet

Harpreet is a UX/UI and brand designer with a developer background.
He works on digital products, brand identity, design systems, and case-study driven product design.
Based in Vienna, Austria, with experience at Raiffeisen Software and prior work in software engineering.

Core skills:
- User Experience Design
- Interface Design
- Design Systems
- Brand Identity
- Prototyping
- User Research
- Visual Design

## Project case studies

- Bottle Pirates: https://harpreet-n.github.io/happydesign/project/bottle-pirates
  Social wine marketplace app (UX/UI, community, marketplace).

- Weight Loss Program for Online Fitness Coaches: https://harpreet-n.github.io/happydesign/project/weight-loss-conversion
  Conversion-focused UX case study for fitness coach landing pages.

- Gassner Mobile App Redesign: https://harpreet-n.github.io/happydesign/project/focasma
  Mobile UX/UI redesign for industrial measurement and monitoring.

- MyDiabetes Website Redesign: https://harpreet-n.github.io/happydesign/project/mydiabetes
  Healthcare website redesign for diabetes support community.

- Caffé Stella Polare: https://harpreet-n.github.io/happydesign/project/caffe-stella-polare
  Branding and web concept for a historic Trieste coffeehouse.

- MyDiabetes Mobile Game Redesign: https://harpreet-n.github.io/happydesign/project/mydiabetes-game
  Educational game UX/UI redesign for children learning about diabetes.

- Xocoatl Branding: https://harpreet-n.github.io/happydesign/project/xocoatl-branding
  Brand identity and packaging for an Aztec cocoa drink concept.

- Agility Plus: https://harpreet-n.github.io/happydesign/project/agility-plus
  Sports/rehab training product UX and brand design.

- Burrito Casa: https://harpreet-n.github.io/happydesign/project/burrito-casa
  Concept branding project for a modern food brand.

- TailMate: https://harpreet-n.github.io/happydesign/project/tailmate
  Concept redesign for a dog adoption platform.
